sources.finding: The V2 developer-menu installer has a direct public MediaFire archive and a source HEN/CFW label. The separate V1 links include gated hosts; no V1 gate was bypassed. The static V2 source image shows a 4.91 CEX showcase footer, which does not establish 4.93 support.
The listed HEN SPRX tool v5.5.6 download redirects to an unlock page. No ready build was downloaded through that gate.
The source lists digital SPRX tool v1.1.4 and an older beta with NPEB/NPUB and HEN/CFW labels. Downloads use unlock pages; no build or compatibility claim was inferred from those labels.
HEN Icon Changer v2.0.2 download buttons use unlock pages. No ready package was acquired through those gates.
The fetched page only exposes a showcase embed and no direct ready console download. No video was copied, embedded or linked in the catalogue.
